home.title: VAMSHA
home.welcome_desc: Discover our lineage, relationships, and special astrological details. Select a primary member to explore the interactive tree display.

home_person.select_desc: Select or change the primary focus person to initialize the lineage tree display.
home_person.configured: You have configured {name} ({id}) as the home focus.
home_person.tip_desc: You can return to this page anytime in the future to change your focus person or explore from another branch.

settings.title: Settings
settings.install_desc: Add Vamsha App to your phone's home screen for a fast, full-screen experience (works offline after first load).
settings.install_disabled_info: If this button is disabled, the app may already be installed or your browser does not support one-click install. Follow the manual steps below.
settings.ios_desc: iOS does not support one-click install. Follow these simple steps:
settings.ios_step2: Tap the Share button (square with arrow up) at the bottom.
settings.ios_step3: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen".
settings.ios_step4: Tap Add in the top right corner.
settings.safety_desc: This is NOT an APK or Play Store application. It only creates a shortcut to this website on your phone's home screen.
settings.safety_bullet1: No files are downloaded to your phone.
settings.safety_bullet4: You can remove it anytime by deleting the icon.
settings.safety_footer: Your phone security and privacy remain completely safe.
settings.birthday_gen_desc: Limit the birthday list to family members within a certain number of generations from the Home Person.

birthdays.title: Upcoming Birthdays
birthdays.desc: List of family members celebrating their birthdays in the next 15 days.
birthdays.no_birthdays: No upcoming birthdays in the next 15 days.
birthdays.no_home_person: Please select a Home Person to filter birthdays by generation.
birthdays.whatsapp_wish_msg: Happy Birthday, {name}! Wishing you a wonderful year ahead.

reports.title: Family Reports & Stats
reports.subtitle: Complete statistics and comprehensive lineage reports for our family tree.
